rules.name: Pipeline Surge vs Capacity Redlined
rules.description: Sales pipeline volume is surging while delivery and resource capacity is redlined or constrained.
rules.rationale_template: Sales pipeline surged by {pipeline_growth_pct}% to {pipeline_value}, while delivery capacity is at {capacity_utilization_pct}% ({capacity_status}). New commitments risk project delivery delays and customer dissatisfaction.

rules.name: Margin Erosion vs Dead Stock Accumulation
rules.description: Gross margins are compressing while dead or non-moving inventory is accumulating.
rules.rationale_template: Gross margins compressed by {margin_compression_bps} bps while dead stock reached {dead_stock_value}. Unsold inventory is tying up operating capital amidst narrowing margins.

rules.name: Support SLA Breach Trend vs Contract Renewal Due
rules.description: Critical enterprise agreements are up for renewal while customer support tickets exhibit SLA breaches.
rules.rationale_template: Enterprise agreement renewal is due within {renewal_window_days} days, but customer support tickets show an SLA breach rate of {sla_breach_rate_pct}%. Churn risk is elevated.
